# Bundled CroCo

CroCo model and utility modules support the DUSt3R backbone. The optional CUDA
RoPE extension is in `models/curope/`; its PyTorch fallback supports the core
CLICK3R demo and training checks. Unused upstream notebooks and task demos are
omitted from this snapshot.

Upstream: [naver/croco](https://github.com/naver/croco).
Keep `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` with this source.
